article.story: ALBANY, N.Y. -- — Gavin Doty had 21 points in Siena's 69-50 win against Marist on Thursday. Doty added seven rebounds for the Saints (14-7, 7-3 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference). Justice Shoats scored 12 points, finishing 6 of 15 from the floor. Brendan Coyle finished with 10 points. The Red Foxes (12-7, 6-4) were led by Rhyjon Blackwell, who recorded 13 points. Jason Schofield added 11 points and two blocks for Marist. Justin Menard had 11 points and five assists. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
